task: pick up the black bowl on the ramekin and place it on the plate
diagnostic_scope: one fixed held-out success/failure pair; not an accuracy estimate
normalization: each model divided by its own success-rollout final cumulative reward
ideal_reference: visual aid only; linear on success and zero on failure, not used by any model
comparison_notes: One held-out success/failure pair; not a policy success-rate evaluation.
JEV uses oracle-filtered simulator state; the principal visual baselines use RGB.
Positive running-best increments are local adaptations; methods use different sampling counts.
TemporalOT retains negative native costs and is excluded from the main normalized comparison.

models.label: VIP
models.curve_definition: positive increments of running-best raw progress

models.label: TemporalOT
models.ratio_interpretation: Both native returns are negative costs. The positive ratio is a cost-magnitude ratio: failure is more negative/worse, not 2.53x more rewarding.
models.curve_definition: cumulative sum of released negative diagonal transport costs
